title: delphinium carolinianum subsp. penardii
intro: Delphinium carolinianum subsp. penardii, commonly known as Carolina larkspur, is a plant species native to the southeastern United States. The health benefits of this plant include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Carolina larkspur include its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its potential to exhibit sedative and diuretic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include delphinine and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
